landing.name: Emely García
landing.phrase: Designing, developing, and maintaining scalable, high-performance web applications.

experience.title: My Experience
experience.description:
Hey, I'm a Front-End Developer with almost 5 years of experience.
I love building fast, scalable web apps that look and feel great.
I'm comfortable working with React, Angular, and modern web tools.
I've worked with Agile teams from different parts of the world, such as India, the United States, and Canada.
Clean code, testing, and performance are super important to me.

items.description:
As a designer and web developer, Led the design and development of a POS system for small and medium businesses.
Built key features for a hybrid mobile app and helped connect it across platforms.

As an Angular developer, I worked to create dynamic, business-focused UI layouts with top-notch usability and responsive design.
Built clean, reusable code with a strong focus on quality and scalability.
Delivered updates constantly, following continuous delivery best practices.

As a Senior Frontend Developer I had the chance to work at WOTDev and Quickplay, leading and developing projects for OTT platforms.
I focused on making streaming experiences smooth and fast for web and SmartTV apps.
Designed clean, high-performing interfaces using HTML, CSS, JavaScript, TypeScript, Angular and React.
Built and maintained SDKs to help different clients easily connect to the platforms.
Worked hands-on with Agile teams to drive projects forward and deliver great results.

I currently work as a React Developer at Elaniin, contributing to a large-scale government project alongside a team of more than 10 collaborators, delivering a robust and scalable web solution.

My role focuses on building high-performance, maintainable user interfaces using React, TypeScript, and modern frontend technologies, translating business requirements and design specifications into efficient, reusable components. I actively work on performance optimization, API integration, and ensuring a smooth, responsive user experience. I collaborate closely with designers, product managers, and engineers in an Agile environment, participating in code reviews, continuous improvements, and the adoption of best practices.

quote.author: Steve Jobs
quote.text: The only way to do great work is to love what you do.

hero.description: A curated index of applications, platforms, and experiments built through deliberate architecture, clean implementation, and continuous iteration.

engineering.subtitle: ENGINEERING APPROACH
engineering.title: Building systems that stay maintainable.
engineering.description: Every project is designed with scalability, readability, and long-term ownership in mind. Beyond shipping features, I focus on architecture decisions, performance, and developer experience to ensure software remains reliable as requirements evolve.

cta.subtitle: NEXT STEP
cta.title: Interested in working together?
cta.description: Whether you're building a product from scratch, improving an existing platform, or exploring new technical ideas, I'm always open to discuss new challenges.

cards.featuredDescription: The featured slot is tuned for the strongest portfolio entry: commerce, visual polish, and product-grade interaction density.

descriptions.random-qa:
RandomAQ is a question-and-answer application developed for educational purposes and built as two connected apps working together.
The Angular admin panel lets administrators create and manage categories, questions, and answers through a structured interface. The Ionic mobile app lets users pick a category and receive a randomly generated question with a 30-second timer.
RandomAQ shows full-stack thinking, cross-platform delivery, and real-time interaction design.
descriptions.fast-messages:
FastMessages is a real-time messaging application developed for educational purposes with the MEAN stack and Socket.IO.
Users can create accounts, log in securely, manage contact lists, and exchange instant messages with live updates.
The project demonstrates full-stack development, real-time data handling, and scalable application architecture.
descriptions.wheather-tv:
Weather TV is one of my first TV projects, built with React for the Tizen-Samsung OS.
It retrieves the user's location and real-time weather data, then presents the information in a clean interface optimized for TV screens.
The project shows how to adapt web technologies for smart TV environments, integrate external APIs, and build friendly interfaces with React.
descriptions.ecom-app:
Ecom App is a modern online shop frontend project built with React and Redux Toolkit.
The UI was designed in Figma and includes product listings, detailed product pages, cart management, and state persistence through Redux.
The project highlights a scalable frontend architecture, efficient state management, and a user-centered design approach.
descriptions.playely-web:
Playely Web is a multilingual OTT frontend project built with Angular and Angular Material.
It integrates with TMDB to fetch movies and TV shows, and it includes lazy loading, a collections view, and a custom player screen.
The project is responsive, modular, and designed to showcase maintainable Angular architecture.
descriptions.playely-tv:
Playely TV is an OTT frontend project built with React and integrated with TMDB.
It includes a collections view, a custom player screen, and was tested on a Samsung Smart TV to validate TV-specific layout and performance needs.
The project highlights React development, media-focused interfaces, and smart TV optimization.
descriptions.swiftmap-app:
SwiftMap is a React project built with Leaflet to create an interactive mapping experience.
The application follows Taylor Swift's concert tour around the world and displays detailed information for each show.
It demonstrates third-party library integration, interactive UI development, and creative data presentation.
descriptions.brisland-ui-app:
Brisland UI App is a tourism-focused country page built with React and enhanced with GSAP animations.
The application presents a fictional travel destination through a visually engaging and interactive interface with responsive layouts and motion effects.
It demonstrates frontend design, animation work, and user experience best practices.
descriptions.invittalo-admin-app:
Invittalo Admin is a production-ready application built with Angular 17 and Angular Material.
It is designed to manage invitations and confirmations for events, including guest lists, invitation delivery, and RSVP tracking.
The project shows clean UI work, responsive design, and scalable architecture for a real-world workflow.
descriptions.invittalo-xv-app:
Invittalo XV is a production-ready invitation app built with Angular and animated with GSAP for a client's XV birthday event.
It presents the final digital invitation with the event location, date, gift table, and RSVP confirmation section in a personalized theme.
The project was developed with CI/CD practices and Git Flow, showing professional delivery and animation-focused Angular work.
